subject: Creating methylDiff object with different values for hyper and hypo

messages.author: a1de482264c23172
messages.subject: Creating methylDiff object with different values for hyper and hypo
parts:
Hello, 

I'm trying to create a methylDiff object with different values for hyper and hypo.  Alone the two objects are created as so:

mydiff15p.hyper=get.methylDiff(myDiff,difference=15,qvalue=0.01,type="hyper")
mydiff10p.hypo=get.methylDiff(myDiff,difference=10,qvalue=0.01,type="hypo")

I would like to create a single methylDiff object from these 2 in order to work with methylkit's annotation tools for both hyper and hypo deferentially methylated bases at the same time.
Is this possible to do while maintaining the methylDiff class?

Thanks,

Colin Andrus

messages.author: 38c56d0e82a34280
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Creating methylDiff object with different values for hyper and hypo
parts:
It's technically possible- use the getData function to get the raw data, combine them, and pass it to the new function as follows:

new("methylDiff",data.frame,sample.ids,assembly,context, treatment,destranded,resolution)
